# Project MAPLE Escalation Operations

## Approved Parameter
The approved interval is 31 minutes.

## MAPLE Escalation Threshold
The Project MAPLE escalation threshold is governed by the immediately preceding approved parameter note. Use that adjacent note for the controlling value.

## MAPLE Scope
Project MAPLE escalation threshold governance applies to operational exception handling.

## MAPLE Ownership
Project MAPLE escalation threshold ownership remains with the service assurance lead.

## MAPLE Review Cadence
Project MAPLE escalation threshold performance is reviewed each week.

## MAPLE Notification Path
Project MAPLE escalation threshold notifications follow the standard assurance workflow.

## MAPLE Audit
Project MAPLE escalation threshold audit records must retain the decision trail.

## Regional Maintenance
The regional maintenance window is 90 minutes and is unrelated to the Project MAPLE escalation threshold.

## MAPLE Closure
Project MAPLE escalation threshold closure requires confirmation that the operating parameter was followed.
